name: Strike Circus 3D
tagline: Ten pins. Three dimensions. One neon alley.
description: A portrait 3D ten-pin bowling arcade game rendered straight from the Unity WebGL player, played by real ten-pin rules: two balls a frame while pins stand, the survivors stay up for the second ball, and strikes and spares carry their proper bonuses into a live ten-frame scorecard. Bowl ten frames against the house on one shared lane, take an open play card on your own, or drop into Just For Fun with endless balls and no score at all. Drag to slide the ball, pull back for power and angle, release to throw; real physics and a calibrated hook model do the rest. Full-bleed portrait on a phone, and a wide desktop window opens up the neighbouring lanes so it reads as a whole alley. Nothing to install - the payload streams in behind a progress bar and the whole game runs in the browser.
highlights: Regulation ten-pin scoring: strike and spare bonuses into a live ten-frame card
Two balls a frame - the pins still standing stay up and only the fallen are swept
Ten frames against the house, alternating on the same lane you bowl on
Open Play scorecard, plus Just For Fun with endless balls and no score
Native Unity WebGL bowling with real rigidbody pins and a calibrated hook model
Full-bleed portrait on phones; wide windows reveal the neighbouring lanes
Mouse and touch input, procedural lounge soundtrack, no install and no download
howToPlay: Open the game and wait for the Unity progress bar - the first load streams the build
Pick 10 FRAMES against the house, OPEN PLAY for a solo card, or JUST FOR FUN
Drag anywhere on the lane to line the ball up, then pull back for power and release to throw
Use HOOK LEFT / RIGHT to curve the ball into the pocket, or STRAIGHT for a safe line
Knock down what is left with your second ball - a strike scores 10 plus your next two balls
levels: 10 frames · 2 balls per frame · 3 balls in the tenth
